news.title: Trump says British PM told him North Sea will open to oil
news.summary:
STORY: :: Trump says new British PM Andy Burnham told him he plans to open the North Sea to oil development 

:: Washington, D.C. / July 29, 2026

"He said he's going to open up North Sea oil. If he does that, you're going to be a wealthy country, if he does it reasonably."

"Norway's got trillions of dollars in the bank. Trillions. It sells its oil from the North Sea. And Scotland has a better part of the North Sea. And you have 500, 600, 700 years. You have areas of the North Sea that haven't even been explored yet. You have one of the most valuable oil finds anywhere in the world. And if the United Kingdom would use it, they'd be a wealthy country again.  And I tell you what I could not get Starmer to use it. It was incredible."

Exploration for oil and gas in the North Sea started in the 1960s and commercial production started in 1975. The basin reached peak output of 4.4 million barrels of oil equivalent per day (boed) at the start of the millennium.
